name: Film and Faith
big_question: How can a film tell a religious story without ever naming a religion?

lessons.title: Religious meaning in film
lessons.big_question: Can a story about a talking lion tell you what Christians believe?
aims: DESCRIBE — four basic Christian beliefs about sin and Jesus
DISCUSS — what the lion Aslan stands for in Narnia
EXPLAIN — how Narnia shows Christian beliefs as symbols

questions: What is your favourite film, and why is it your favourite?
Does a film have to mention God to teach a religious idea?
Name a film where a character gives something up for a friend.

learn.caption: The Chronicles of Narnia: belief becomes symbol
rows: Humans made a mistake: this is sin
Someone had to pay the price
God's own Son became a man
The Son of God died in our place
The Son of God rose from the dead

source.quote: Aslan resurrects because he gave his life for Edmund even though Aslan had made no mistake. After his resurrection, they can overcome the Witch.
source.attrib: — Unit 6 lesson slides, on Narnia and Christian belief
source.task: Underline the part that matches a Christian belief. Then name the belief and say why it matches.

stretch.question: The Chronicles of Narnia can relate to many of the teachings within Christianity.

debate.statement: Narnia is just a story about a lion, not a story about religion
agree: Narnia never uses the word God or Jesus, so it is simply an exciting adventure story.
Most children watch Narnia for the battles and talking animals, not for a lesson on sin.
disagree: Aslan dies for Edmund and then rises again, which is exactly the Christian story of Jesus.
The writer put the symbols there on purpose, so the religious meaning is built in.
debate.how_to_win: Use one scene from Narnia as your evidence, then name the Christian belief it stands for.

quickfire.q: Which hero of faith fought apartheid?
Who gave the I Have a Dream speech?
Which young hero was shot for going to school?
Who led India to freedom without violence?
In Narnia, which character stands for Jesus?
Which word means a wrong choice against God?

lessons.title: Prayer in films
lessons.big_question: What can three film prayers teach us about why people pray?
aims: DESCRIBE — what prayer is and the forms it can take
DISCUSS — why the characters in three films pray
EXPLAIN — how a film shows faith through a prayer scene

questions: Why do people pray? Does praying increase or decrease faith?
Have you seen a character pray in a film? What did they want?
Can a person pray anywhere, or do they need a holy building?

learn.caption: Three film prayers and what each one asks for
rows: Facing the Giants: a coach prays
Hunchback of Notre Dame: she prays
Home Alone: Kevin goes into a church
Personal prayer: alone, own words
Corporate prayer: said as a group

source.quote: Prayer: an act of communication by humans with the sacred or holy God. Found in all religions in all times, prayer may be a group act or a personal act.
source.attrib: — Unit 6 lesson slides, on what prayer is
source.task: Highlight the words that say who a prayer is aimed at. Then say if Kevin's prayer is group or personal.

stretch.question: Explain what The Lord is my rock, my protection means to a person who prays.

debate.statement: Praying in a film is only a way to show a character has run out of options
agree: Kevin only goes into the church in Home Alone when he is lonely and afraid at Christmas.
In Facing the Giants the coach prays when his team keeps losing and nothing else works.
disagree: Prayer is communication with God, so it is a relationship and not a last resort.
Believers also pray in good times, to say thank you and to pray for other people.
debate.how_to_win: Say what each character asks for, then say whether the prayer is only about themselves.

quickfire.q: Which hero of faith spent 27 years in prison?
Which hero campaigned for girls' schooling?
Which lion in Narnia stands for Jesus?
Who tempts Edmund with Turkish Delight?
Give the meaning of the word prayer.
Name one film with a prayer scene.

lessons.title: Temptation in movies
lessons.big_question: Why do stories keep warning us about giving in to temptation?
aims: DESCRIBE — what temptation means, with an example
DISCUSS — the choice Adam and Eve made in the Bible
EXPLAIN — how a cartoon teaches a lesson about temptation

questions: Is giving in to temptation always a bad thing?
Name something people are often tempted to do at school.
Who is to blame: the one who tempts, or the one who gives in?

learn.caption: Temptation: the choice, the fall and the fix
rows: Temptation: wanting to do wrong
Adam and Eve were given a choice
They chose wrong and gave in
The consequence: a split from God
Larry Boy and the Bad Apple

source.quote: The basic teaching about temptation in the Bible comes from the story of Adam and Eve. They had a chance between right or wrong. They chose wrong. They gave into temptation.
source.task: Underline the moment of choice. Then write what this choice caused between people and God.

stretch.question: What does Watch and pray so you will not fall into temptation mean? (Matthew 26:41)

debate.statement: People cannot help giving in to temptation, so they should not be blamed
agree: The Bible itself says the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak, so people are not strong.
Adam and Eve were the first humans, and even they gave in almost straight away.
disagree: Adam and Eve had a real chance between right and wrong, so the choice was truly theirs.
The same verse says watch and pray, so people are told how to resist temptation.
debate.how_to_win: Use Adam and Eve on one side and the Matthew verse on the other, then decide which is stronger.

quickfire.q: Which hero used peaceful protest in India?
Which hero of faith led South Africa?
What does the word prayer mean?

What does the word temptation mean?
Which Bible pair gave in to temptation?

lessons.title: Resurrection in movies
lessons.big_question: Why do so many modern films bring their hero back from the dead?
aims: DESCRIBE — what the word resurrection means
DISCUSS — where the idea of resurrection came from
EXPLAIN — how two modern films show a resurrection

questions: Name a film where a character dies and comes back to life.
Is coming back to life the same as never having died at all?
Why might a story feel unfinished if the hero stays dead?

learn.caption: Resurrection: the belief and the films
rows: Resurrection: brought back to life
Believed by Jews, Christians, Muslims
Jesus rose in a body people touched
Harry Potter dies, then returns
Superman dies, then is brought back

source.quote: Potter had to die to let a part of Voldemort that lives in him die. He came back to life in his body to help his friends win the war against the forces of darkness.
source.attrib: — Unit 6 lesson slides, on resurrection in films
source.task: Underline what Harry gains by dying. Then give one way this is like, and one way it is unlike, Jesus.

stretch.question: What have you learnt about the resurrection of Jesus Christ?

debate.statement: Superman rising from the dead is just a copy of the story of Jesus
agree: Superman dies to save humanity and is brought back to save it again, just like Jesus.
Writers know that audiences already know the Jesus story, so it makes the hero feel holy.
disagree: Superman is brought back by other heroes, while Christians believe God raised Jesus.
Stories about the dead returning existed long before films, so this is not simply copying.
debate.how_to_win: Compare who does the raising in each story, then say whether that difference matters.
